name: brand-ai-readiness-audit
description: Audits any website for the problems that stop AI assistants finding, trusting and citing it, and that stop assistant-referred visitors staying once they land. Produces one structured report of evidence-backed findings and prioritized fixes.

skills.description: Entrypoint. Scopes the audit, triggers one collection, runs every analyzer over it, normalises severity, de-duplicates by root cause and emits the single audit report.
Stage 1 - reach. Owns all network I/O: collects the site pack, then checks robots.txt gating by agent role, snippet directives, bot walls, sitemaps, canonicalisation and latency.
Stage 2 - read. Detects content that exists for a browser but not for a text fetcher: JavaScript-assembled pages, facts locked in images or media, iframe and interaction-gated content.
Stage 3 - parse. Checks schema.org validity, type coverage gated by site type, required properties, entity identity fields and agreement between markup and visible content.
Stage 4 - quote. Checks whether pages state self-contained, checkable facts an assistant can lift: definitional sentences, real numbers, chunk boundaries and question-shaped content.
Stage 5 - trust. Checks dates, attribution, entity disambiguation and the off-site agreement that decides whether an extracted fact is repeated.
Stage 6 - stay. Checks whether a visitor who lands deep from an assistant answer is oriented, unblocked, and able to continue the task.
